exercises.title: Analysis practices 1 — which practice fits?
exercises.problemHtml:
Choose the analysis practice that fits each situation.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chọn thực hành phân tích phù hợp với từng tình huống.

Mỗi dòng được chấm riêng; giải thích từng đáp án hiện sau khi nộp.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Analysis practices 1 — which practice fits? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: Model the application environment
   - r1.k: Create user interface and technical prototypes
   - r2.k: Analyze requirement feasibility
   - r3.k: Prioritize the requirements
   - r4.k: Create a data dictionary
   - r5.k: Analyze external interfaces
   - r6.k: Allocate requirements to subsystems
   - r7.k: Model the requirements
   Analysis turns raw input into a consistent, feasible, prioritised set — models, prototypes and the data dictionary are its tools.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Analysis turns raw input into a consistent, feasible, prioritised set — models, prototypes and the data dictionary are its tools.

bang.de:
Choose the right value for every row.

Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.

luaChon: Create user interface and technical prototypes

o.s: Nobody is sure how the new system connects to the hospital’s lab, billing and pharmacy systems.
Users cannot picture the new triage screen.
A customer wants real-time GPS for 10,000 buses on a tiny budget.
There is more work than one release can hold.
"Patient", "client" and "member" are used for the same thing in three departments.
Data must be exchanged with the national health portal in a defined format.
A building access product has badges, door locks, cameras and guards.
A state diagram of an order reveals that cancelled orders can still be shipped.

dapAn.r1.k: Create user interface and technical prototypes

bang.giaiThich: Analysis turns raw input into a consistent, feasible, prioritised set — models, prototypes and the data dictionary are its tools.

mistakesJson.loi: Gọi việc đặt tên thống nhất là glossary (Knowledge) thay vì data dictionary.
Nhầm external interfaces với environment model.

glossaryJson.vi: phân tích yêu cầu — làm rõ, mô hình hoá, phát hiện thiếu/xung đột
từ điển dữ liệu — định nghĩa mọi phần tử dữ liệu (thành phần, kiểu, độ dài, giá trị hợp lệ)
nguyên mẫu — bản thử để làm rõ yêu cầu (throwaway / evolutionary, mock-up / proof of concept)

exercises.title: Analysis practices 2 — allocate to subsystems
exercises.problemHtml:
For a secure-building access product, allocate each requirement to the subsystem that will satisfy it: software, hardware or people (guards, operators).

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Analysis practices 3 — feasibility and models
exercises.problemHtml:
Analyse feasibility with developers to surface risks, conflicts and dependencies early; infeasible or costly requirements can often be simplified while still meeting the business objectives. Analysis models can reveal incorrect, inconsistent, missing or superfluous requirements.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Phân tích khả thi cùng dev; mô hình lộ ra yêu cầu sai, mâu thuẫn, thiếu hoặc thừa.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

hintsJson: Đắt ⇒ tìm phương án đơn giản hơn đạt cùng mục tiêu.
Mô hình giúp thấy chỗ thiếu.

# Analysis practices 3 — feasibility and models — answer key

1. A requirement turns out to be very expensive. The analyst should first…Một yêu cầu hoá ra rất đắt. BA nên trước tiên…
   Answer: c) look for a simpler version that still meets the business objective
   Simplify while keeping the objective.VI: Đơn giản hoá mà giữ mục tiêu.

2. Which defect can a model reveal that a text list hides?Model lộ ra lỗi nào mà danh sách văn bản che đi?
   Answer: d) A missing transition, e.g. no way to reopen a closed ticket
   Models expose gaps and inconsistencies.VI: Mô hình lộ lỗ hổng và mâu thuẫn.

exercises.title: Analysis practices 4 — environment and interfaces
exercises.problemHtml:
A context diagram shows the boundary and the interfaces with users, devices and other systems; an ecosystem map shows the systems in the solution space and how they interconnect. Every system has external interfaces: user interfaces, data exchanges, hardware links, communication interfaces.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Context diagram và ecosystem map; mọi hệ thống đều có giao diện ngoài.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Analysis practices 4 — environment and interfaces — answer key

1. Which model shows several systems and how they exchange data with each other, beyond your own system?Mô hình nào cho thấy nhiều hệ thống và cách chúng trao đổi dữ liệu với nhau, ngoài hệ thống của bạn?
   Answer: a) Ecosystem map
   The context diagram shows only your system’s direct neighbours.VI: Context diagram chỉ thấy hàng xóm trực tiếp.

2. Why analyse external interfaces early?Vì sao phân tích giao diện ngoài sớm?
   Answer: d) So the application fits smoothly into its environment; interface changes are costly later
   Late interface surprises are expensive.VI: Bất ngờ về giao diện về sau rất đắt.
